name: Monster Ops 16
storyline:
Wraith and Tide thought they had triumphed over Major Denise when they hid the last carrier of her monster virus DNA in a remote swamp. But suddenly their bunker hideaway is getting smashed into by two new Class A monsters! Gem had to have betrayed their location and that means he's switched sides!

Their worst nightmare has come true. Major Denise has the DNA she needed, and will make her monster virus in short order. The two soldiers can't continue their honeymooning. They must take any risk necessary to kill Denise Hanson!

Meanwhile, Gila and Harse just want to run away and live off the land together in peaceful serenity, but they can't escape the mind-control chip Denise put in Gila's head. Harse stays with him hoping he can find a way to free him, but he has lost all loyalty for Denise.
summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!
